svg.desc: Languages: C++, Python, C, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL. Web & Backend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite, FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, Flutter, WebSockets, SSE, JWT / RBAC. Data & DevOps: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions, pytest. AI & ML: LightGBM, NetworkX, LLM Agents, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Codex
